title: Acquirer: Mayne Health; Target: Queensland Diagnostic Imaging Pty Limited

body_sections.Summary: Healthcare Imaging Services Pty Limited (a wholly owned subsidiary of Mayne Group Limited) proposed acquisition of Queensland Diagnostic Imaging Pty Limited
body_sections.Market definition: The Sunshine Coast market for the provision of diagnostic services to private patients
body_sections.Competition analysis: "	It appears that the barriers to entry for diagnostic imaging may not be high; "	It appears that there are a number of diagnostic services providers not presently competing in the relevant market which would be able to enter the relevant market easily; "	There are a number of available substitutes who would be able to expand existing operations in which are located on the Sunshine Coast; and "	Countervailing power appears to be present among customers including private hospitals and health funds particularly through the presence of a competitive tendering process for hospital based facilities.  Additionally, medical practitioners can refer patients to a competing diagnostic imaging provider or to assist a new entrant.
